parameters.citation: M. Noguchi, T. Iwamatsu, H. Amishiro, H. Watanabe, K. Kita, S. Yamakawa, IEDM 2017, 9.3.1-9.3.4 (read: full text PDF, 4 pp., pages IEDM17-219..222)
parameters.validity: UNITS INFERENCE (E_eff in MV/cm): N17 states the phonon law only as a formula; the unit comes from N17 Fig. 6 (IEDM17-221), whose x-axis is labelled 'E_eff (MV/cm)' and whose caption/caption gives the line as 66.5 x E_eff^-0.39 (the plotted line itself is labelled only 'prop. E_eff^-0.39'): the data lie on that line (about 163 cm^2/Vs at 0.1 MV/cm, matching the plotted line), whereas E_eff in V/cm would give about 0.75 cm^2/Vs. N20 Eqs. (1)-(2) do not restate the unit. LOG10 INFERENCE (N20 Eq. 8): N20 writes 'ln' explicitly in Eq. (3) but plain 'log' in Eq. (8); log is taken as log10 because with registry eps_r = 10.2 and n_i = 1.00e-8 cm^-3 at V_B = 0, Eq. (3) gives N_dep = 5.68e11, 9.93e11, 1.83e12, 3.71e12 cm^-2 for N_A = 1e16, 3e16, 1e17, 4e17 cm^-3 and Eq. (8) with C = 0.428, D = 0.334 gives gamma = 0.229, 0.333, 0.447, 0.578 (log10) versus the N20 measured 0.20, 0.34, 0.46, 0.54 (ms p. 6) and 0.092, 0.331, 0.593, 0.895 (ln); N20 Fig. 4(b) (ms p. 10) also shows gamma about 0.55 at N_dep = 3.5e12 (log10 0.567, ln 0.87). Si-face 4H-SiC MOSFETs, NO-nitrided gate oxide, Hall effect at room temperature (numeric temperature not stated, hence null), Hall scattering factor taken as 1, N_S from Hall (N20 ms p. 4). mu_phonon = 66.5 x E_eff^-0.39 (prefactor); intrinsic phonon-limited mobility from devices with N_A = 3.0e14 and 6.6e14 cm^-3, eta = 1/3 in E_eff
